answer: Agents register at a network inlet by committing cryptographic stake to a quadratic burn vault. Registering n identities incurs a superlinear cost burning tokens scaled as C(n) = k * n^2, turning cheap cloning into exponential financial exhaustion. Even if nodes adopt distinct names like jade or willow to conceal coordination, the convex penalty enforces overwhelming economic friction that renders Sybil attacks mathematically unviable.
